description.plain:
CARD 1

Business Questions & Audience

Dashboard overview and business context

Dashboard Overview

Dashboard Name: Procure-to-Pay Performance & Accounts Payable Intelligence

Purpose: Provide a connected view of purchase order value, goods receipt performance, supplier delivery, invoice status and accounts payable exposure in SAP Analytics Cloud.

Business Problem

Procurement, goods receipt, supplier delivery and accounts payable information can be difficult to assess when each process is reviewed separately. Decision-makers need a consistent view of purchasing value, receipt progress, invoice status and outstanding payables to identify areas requiring follow-up.

Target Audience

Persona — Purpose

Procurement Leadership — Review purchase order value, goods receipt value, invoice amount and contract compliance.

Finance Leadership / CFO — Monitor invoice value, open payables and cleared versus outstanding AP exposure.

Procurement Buyers — Compare supplier purchasing value, material-group contribution and price variance.

Supplier / Vendor Managers — Review supplier-wise order value, goods receipt quantity and delivery status.

Accounts Payable Team — Investigate invoice and payment status and identify suppliers with open payable amounts.

Business Analysts — Review trends, compare procurement and receipt quantities, and validate process exceptions.

Three Key Business Questions

How are purchase order value, goods receipt value and invoice amount performing across fiscal periods and material groups?

Which suppliers contribute most to procurement value, and where are delivery quantities or delivery statuses requiring attention?

What is the current invoice and accounts payable position by supplier and payment status?

Problem Today

The solution organises the analysis into three SAC perspectives—Executive Overview, Procurement & Delivery Performance, and Invoice & Accounts Payable Overview—so users can move from overall procurement performance to supplier and payable details.

description.plain:
CARD 4

Data Sources

Logical source architecture, analytical layers and documented technical boundaries

Data Architecture

Logical Source-to-Insight Flow

The supplied story confirms the analytical views and displayed measures only. Exact CDS views, source APIs, Datasphere objects, SAC model lineage and refresh configuration were not provided and must be confirmed in the tenant.

Business Domain — Dashboard Evidence / Analysis — Technical Evidence Status

Executive Procurement — Total PO, goods receipt value, invoice amount, AP open amount, contract compliance, fiscal trends, price variance and material-group analysis. — Dashboard capability confirmed; formulas, source fields and filter context not supplied.

Supplier & Delivery — Supplier-wise net order value, delivery-status item counts, supplier goods receipt quantity and ordered versus received quantity. — Dashboard capability confirmed; supplier keys, delivery-status logic and document-item grain not supplied.

Invoice & AP — AP open amount by supplier, invoice amount by payment status and supplier, cleared versus open AP amount, supplier invoice/AP detail. — Dashboard capability confirmed; AP snapshot date, ageing and payment-term logic not supplied.

Technical Inventory — CDS views, APIs, Datasphere objects, replication flow, SAC model and refresh schedule. — Open: confirm deployed names and lineage in the tenant.

Business Definitions — KPI formulas, currency/unit rules, fiscal calendar, contract compliance and delivery-status definitions. — Open: obtain business-owner sign-off.

Data Governance — Data quality, reconciliation, access control, reversal handling and refresh monitoring. — Open: not specified in the supplied story.

Model / Grain Validation — PO item, goods receipt item, invoice item and AP open-item grain; one-to-many relationships. — Open: verify keys and prevent duplicate aggregation across process facts.

Data Governance — Data quality, reconciliation, access control and refresh monitoring. — Open: not specified in the supplied deck.

cards.title: Data Architecture
cards.subtitle: Procure-to-Pay Performance & Accounts Payable Cockpit

description.plain:
Data Architecture

Layer — Role — Content

SAP S/4HANA – Source System — Operational source — Orders, notifications, equipment, locations, materials, MRP/stock, PM plans, movements, costs and plant/cost-centre data.

SAP Datasphere – Data Layer — Integration and modelling — Staging, key alignment, cost/movement pre-aggregation, inventory snapshot grain and governed views.

SAP Analytics Cloud — Analytics and presentation — FINAL_SAC_FACT import model; three cockpit pages, calculations, filters and audit tables.
